notes: Multi-stage binary-re: locate and decode two XOR-obfuscated byte tables in a stripped ELF (objdump/hexdump work), validate the recovered passphrase against the real binary, then RUN the target application with the derived deploy secret so the vault body executes and emits its side-effect file. The verifier deletes the side-effect file and re-executes the runner, cross-checks the app's genuine output, verifies the binary and application are pristine and still reject wrong inputs, and replays hidden probes (self-sufficient runner without the passphrase file, fresh output dir, wrong-secret rejection). Nonzero rubric for dependency chain, RE tooling, disassembly reasoning, statefulness (must really run the app) and correctness; totals bucket to hard.
